input: Search the web for kids' "summer program" offerings (programs that don't call themselves camps) for kids and teens in Haywood, Jackson and Swain counties, NC (Waynesville, Canton, Sylva, Cherokee). Use that wording in your searches, not just "camp", and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: Haywood County 4-H — N.C. Cooperative Extension
candidates.note: Listed local 2026 summer programs separately from its out-of-area overnight camp trip.

candidates.name: Haywood Haven
candidates.note: Summer 2025 Community Center for K–6, Tuesdays and Thursdays, June–August, 8:30 a.m.–3 p.m.

candidates.name: First United Methodist Church of Sylva
candidates.note: Early Learning Center offers a distinct June–July summer program for ages 3 months–5 years.

candidates.name: Southwestern Community College
candidates.note: Upward Bound summer college-preparation institute for eligible local high-school students; operated in 2025.

candidates.name: Cherokee Youth Center — Boys & Girls Clubs of Cherokee
candidates.note: Summer youth program for ages 5–18/K–12; organization published a 2025 parent handbook.

candidates.name: Western Carolina University
candidates.note: Free weeklong ACE machining training welcomed high-school students in July and August 2025.

candidates.name: Fontana Regional Library
candidates.note: Jackson County Public Library offered Artrageous and supervised teen Dungeons & Dragons sessions in summer 2025.

candidates.name: Haywood County Schools
candidates.note: 2026 summer information identifies elementary-school summer programs and Read to Achieve sessions.
